explanationMd: An even function satisfies f(−x)=f(x). Both powers in x⁴ + 2x² are even, so substituting −x leaves the expression unchanged. The other choices contain a nonzero odd-power contribution.

distractorRationale.d: This function is odd rather than even.
distractorRationale.c: The linear term breaks even symmetry.
distractorRationale.a: The cubic term breaks even symmetry.
